The '''''Founder''''' was one of the three [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] dispatched by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to defend the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]]. The ship and its companions were all destroyed, demonstrating [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' prowess as a master tactician.
